testInfo.description: German national wallet upstream iOS app; local simulator conformance run
testInfo.summary: Sends a DCQL query that requests a credential by type (vct) but without specifying individual claims. The wallet should still return a matching credential, but because no selectively-disclosable claims were requested it should disclose only mandatory claims and not include SD-JWT disclosures.
